Title: Retirement: Information regarding the end of support for the "Microsoft Translator [DEPRECATED]" connector

Body.Content:
The Microsoft Translator connector has been deprecated since 2020, and the underlying API used has been deprecated since May 2021. On October 30, 2024, the Microsoft Translator connector will no longer be supported and will be disabled on Power Platform. 

How does this affect me?

If action is not taken, beginning October 30, 2024, the application(s) listed above will be impacted and may no longer function as expected.

What action do I need to take?

Please transition to using these supported alternatives to replace Microsoft Translator connector actions:

  • The Detect language action can be transitioned to use the Microsoft Translator V2 connector and the Detect language action. 
  • The Get languages action can be transitioned to use the Microsoft Translator V2 connector and the Get languages action.
  • The Translate text action can be transitioned to use the Microsoft Translator V2 connector and the Translate text action. 
  • The Get speech languages action can be transitioned to use the Azure Text to Speech connector and the Get list of voices action. 
  • The Text to speech action can be transitioned to use the Azure Text to Speech connector and the Convert text to speech action. 

If you have already transitioned your application(s) away from using the "Microsoft Translator [DEPRECATED]" connector, then no further action is required.
